sentences.text: This enantiornithine bird lived approximately 90 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous.
The species was originally described as Ichthyornis maltshevskyi by Nesov in 1986.
The genus Lenesornis was established by Kurochkin in 1996.
The genus Lenesornis belongs to the parent group Alexornithidae.
Fossils of Lenesornis have been found in the Bissekty Formation in the Kyzyl Kum desert of Uzbekistan.
The time range for Lenesornis is the Turonian stage, spanning from 93.9 to 89.8 million years ago.
